summary_en: Public tender offer for Yamadai (TSE Standard, code 7426) completed 6 Jun–3 Aug 2026. Tendered: 365,834 shares (33.0% of ex-treasury S/O) at ¥601/share. Concurrent acquisition from two founding-family shareholders: 338,000 shares without tender. Settlement: 10 Aug 2026. Yamadai becomes Nice's wholly owned subsidiary upon completion.
title_en: Notification Regarding Results of Public Tender Offer for Yamadai Corporation (Code 7426) and Changes to Subsidiaries
translation_en_brief: On 1 June 2026, Nice Corporation announced a public tender offer for all ordinary shares of Yamadai Corporation (TSE Standard, code 7426). The offer ran from 2 June to 3 August 2026 and was structured with a minimum acceptance threshold of 261,700 shares and no upper limit. The offer price was ¥601 per share. The tender offer succeeded, with 365,834 shares tendered, exceeding the minimum condition. Settlement is scheduled for 10 August 2026. Concurrently, Nice will acquire all shares held by two founding-family shareholders (Estate Yamadain and Yamayuki Shokurin, totalling 338,000 shares) without conducting a separate tender, under exemptions in the Financial Instruments and Exchange Act. Upon settlement, Yamadai will become a wholly owned subsidiary of Nice. The target company has 1,110,839 shares outstanding (excluding treasury), so the 365,834 tendered shares represent 33.0% of the ex-treasury float.
